verdict.rationale: Fedora docs confirm one-click installation of desktop apps from Fedora's own repositories, Flathub, or elsewhere, and note that all packages/tools/runtimes are 'ready for use with just a single command,' supporting access to a large official catalog. However, no evidence quantifies catalog size (thousands of apps) and one community report describes friction installing popular apps (Discord/Spotify) requiring manual commands. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of catalog scale, first-party documentation naming exact repo/Flathub app counts, and resolution of the community-reported installation friction.
